social_formats.description: Group formation where dancers hold each other by the shoulder and waist while dancing to dhol, tamak', changu, and mahuri.

movement_profile.arms_and_hands: Arms reaching across adjacent dancers to grip the shoulder and waist
movement_profile.formation_and_space: Group lines or circular formations moving in connected contact
movement_profile.partnering: Group physical connection where dancers hold each other continuous at shoulder and waist
movement_profile.posture: Upright group posture with arms interlocked at the shoulder and waist of neighbouring dancers

signature_moves.description: Dancers interlock by holding adjacent participants firmly by the shoulder and waist while stepping to the drum rhythm.
signature_moves.name: Shoulder-Waist Hold

movement_profile.what_to_avoid: Breaking the continuous group grip at the shoulder and waist during movement

music_profile.musical_form: Mohuria leads on the mahuri while accompanying drummers follow
music_profile.rhythm_pattern: Rhythmic drum patterns played on dhol, tamak', and changu following the mahuri lead line
music_profile.sound_description: The music features high-register melodic phrases from the mahuri wind instrument played by the Mohuria, anchored by steady, repetitive tribal drumming on the dhol, tamak', and changu.

basic_steps: Interlock arms by holding adjacent dancers by the shoulder and waist
Step in group synchronization following the lead beat of the dhol, tamak', changu, and mahuri
teaching.formation: Group formation with physical contact held at shoulder and waist
teaching.level_notes: Beginner groups focus on maintaining continuous physical contact by shoulder and waist while matching the drummer's tempo.
teaching.rhythm: Rhythms set by dhol, tamak', and changu drums following the melodic cues of the Mohuria playing the mahuri
